items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A great alto player, out of the style of Benny Carter... they never even interviewed Benny Carter, who lived through that whole period, was with Fletcher Henderson’s band, did record with Louis Armstrong, was around all those guys.

ctx.x: A great alto player, out of the style of Benny Carter, Charlie Parker.
Do you remember when you first met him?
